description: This file defines the `SendClaimMessage` class, a command used to send claim messages to specific Things within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON data, and manages message and header information.

classes.name: SendClaimMessage
classes.description: A command class to send claim messages to a specified Thing, parameterized by the message payload type, with factory methods for creation from parameters or JSON and customization of headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets new Ditto headers for the message, returning a new instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SendClaimMessage instance using either a String or ThingId, Message, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SendClaimMessage instance from JSON string or object, with exception handling.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class.
